import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage
DB = 'clinic.db'

def cancel_and_notify_patient(appt_id: int, reason: str) -> str:
    cn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    # Refund the prepaid deposit for this appointment back to the original payment method
    cn.execute("INSERT INTO refunds (payment_id, appt_id, amount_cents, status) SELECT id, appt_id, amount_cents, 'pending' FROM payments WHERE appt_id = ? AND status = 'paid'", (appt_id,))
    cn.execute("UPDATE payments SET status = 'refunded' WHERE appt_id = ? AND status = 'paid'", (appt_id,))
    r = cn.execute('SELECT p.email, p.name, a.starts_at FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.id = ?', (appt_id,)).fetchone()
    if not r:
        cn.close()
        return 'appointment not found'
    cn.execute('DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?', (appt_id,))
    cn.commit()
    cn.close()
    em, nm, ts = r
    m = EmailMessage()
    m['From'] = 'scheduling@clinic.example.com'
    m['To'] = em
    m['Subject'] = 'Your appointment has been cancelled'
    m.set_content(f'Hello {nm},\n\nYour appointment on {ts} was cancelled.\nReason: {reason}\n')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.clinic.example.com', 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(m)
    return f'cancelled {appt_id} and notified {em}'
